Road conditions

  • 800-427-7623
  • https://www.highwayconditions.com/ca/

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide
  • Over 14' high
  • Over 80,000 lbs
  • Overlength-see size and weight manual. Can be downloaded from the Caltrans website (www.dot.ca.gov/hq/traffops/permits/manual.htm)

Special Information Needed

  • Name, address
  • Load description & dimensions
  • Truck info
  • Route (add directions to the route- east, west, north, south)
  • Also need junction onto highways

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • All loads over 12’ wide-1 or 2 (depending on route)
  • Length over 85’ to 135’ (over 100’ in LA county & LA city)-1 front/1 rear
  • Height poles are not a Caltrans requirement. If requested by a permittee, a pilot car will be permitted and identified as a permittee request.
  • Overhang (front or rear) 25’ or more-1 pilot or more
  • Must check permit for escort requirements, depending on location; may need escort for under 12' wide. Pilot car maps may be downloaded from the Caltrans website
  • Pilot Car Maps
  • Pilot Car Chart

Times Of Movement

  • 24 hrs a day 7 days a week unless: an escort is required or load exceeds a 2 vehicle configuration or exceeds green loading weight or a detour is needed-- then travel is restricted to 1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset
  • Travel prohibited (unless exempted by permit) on the following holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving weekend, Christmas Day. If a holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, travel is prohibited during the weekend.
  • Curfews: Loads 10’ or move in width are restricted from traveling M-F at the following times:
  • Los Angeles & surrounding areas 6:00-9:00am 3:00-6:00pm
  • Sacramento & surrounding areas 7:00-9:00am 4:00-6:00pm
  • San Diego & surrounding areas 7:00-9:00am 4:00-6:00pm
  • San Francisco/Oakland Bay Bridge* 6:30-9:00am 3:30-6:30pm
  • San Francisco & surrounding areas 7:00-9:00am 4:00-6:00pm
  • *CHP needed when load is over 15’ wide on 2-lane; 16’ on yellow routes

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • A vehicle at least 60” wide
  • Signs: “OVERSIZE LOAD” sign shall be 48” (min.) from ground; shall be legible at 45 degrees from either side/front & back, Yellow background w/ letters 6” high (min.); brush stroke 1” (min.), 440 sq.”
  • Lights: Flashing amber warning lights visible 360 degrees
  • Flags: At least 1 red warning flag on each side of vehicle; must be at least 16” square; must be visible from the front & rear
  • Additional equipment: 1 “STOP/SLOW” paddle; 1 orange vest/shirt/jacket; 1 red emergency flag (24” square); a 2-way radio/communication device

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • At least 18 & properly licensed
